title: Review of c02's FCH field chemoton on fresh seed 9: all four vesicles carry the gated catalyst on their bilayer and persist while fed; after the feed cut the catalyst is gone by t~330 and the vesicles decay into small K-free rings
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_starve.py (feed cut at t=300) unchanged on seed 9. From a white-noise bath three blobs form by t=24 and become bilayer and multilamellar vesicles by t~150; all 4 bodies carry the catalyst K beaded along their bilayer (fork_s9.png row 2), labkit K rim/core 3.61, rim/out 2.69, 15/23 individuals membrane-like; u itself is not membrane-like in aggregate (rim/core 1.4). The fed run holds its bodies and amphiphile total to t=600. In the cut twin K collapses within ~30 t of the cut, and the vesicles shrink at roughly the amphiphile decay rate into small rings (total amphiphile ~0.1 of the fed level at t=600), still present but without catalyst. I support S, I, B and E, with E by construction.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: white noise in u and K over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png and fork_s9.png rows 1-2: 4 vesicles from t~150 to t=600 at constant size, 4 persistent tracks, longest 200 frames
observations.B: fork_s9.png row 2 and rerun/radial.png: K beaded along every bilayer, K rim/core 3.61, rim/out 2.69 (15/23 individuals membrane-like); K has its own autocatalytic production and gated transport, and exists only on the vesicles
observations.E: fork_s9.png rows 3-4 and totals panel: after the feed cut at t=300, K is gone by t~330 and the vesicles shrink to small K-free rings (amphiphile ~0.1 of the fed twin at t=600), while the fed twin holds its vesicles

seeds_run.result: pass: 4 K-carrying vesicles persist when fed; feed cut kills the catalyst within ~30 t and shrinks the vesicles to small rings

controls_run.E: rerun_starve (world_starve.py, feed cut at t=300) against rerun (fed), seed 9, identical until the cut: fork_s9.png

verdicts.limitation: E holds by construction: amphiphile is made only by K from the fed precursor and decays at kap everywhere, so after the cut the vesicles shrink at the decay rate; at t=600 (300 t after the cut) small K-free rings still exist (labkit: 3 components), so the individuals lose their catalyst and most of their matter but have not all vanished. The u channel is not itself a separate boundary layer in aggregate; B rests on the K layer, which needs the bilayer's mobility gate to persist. I did not re-trace the claim's seed-0 track 3. No division. One fresh seed.
